# contraco

> Global hub for contraco digital transformation consulting. Founded 1998 by Frank Meltke. Regional sites: contraco.net (EN), contraco.de (DE), contraco.ru (RU), contraco.co.kr (KO).

## About

contraco is a premium transformation consultancy combining strategic clarity, technological intelligence, and psychological depth. 28 years of experience across Fortune 500 companies on four continents.

## Regional Sites

- [contraco.net](https://contraco.net/) — Global English site, primary domain
- [contraco.de](https://contraco.de/) — Deutschland, Deutsch
- [contraco.ru](https://contraco.ru/) — Россия, Русский
- [contraco.co.kr](https://contraco.co.kr/) — 대한민국, 한국어

## Founder

Frank Meltke. German inventor, entrepreneur, digital transformation expert. Patent DE10313420A1 (2003). Guest lecturer Kyung Hee University Seoul. BBC Global Minds Insight Panelist. Wikidata: Q139680598.
